description: 한국철도공사_연도별 여객 수송(정기) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 이 데이터는 한국철도공사에서 제공하는 ‘연도별 여객 수송(정기)’ 자료로, 한 해 동안 고속철도(KTX), 새마을, 무궁화, 통일호, 비둘기 등 각 열차별 정기 노선에서 운행된 여객. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 연도별 여객 수송(정기), 고속철도 및 일반열차 이용 추이, 열차별 수송량 변화, 수요 및 정책 영향, 노선별 승객 집중. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
